messages:
juan: Bringing up orpheus-70k int4v3 onboard tests. Short repro: after ~32.7k tokens model output starts truncating tokens near the boundary.
rachel: Can you paste a minimal snippet of the failure?
juan: gist: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/1771112222/snippet.txt 
juan: failing output: `...and the quick brown fox jumped ove` expected `...jumped over`
liam: interesting, looks like a single-char drop when crossing 32768->32769. Could be posscale underflow at RoPE wrap.
juan: logs show positions: ```ROPE_POS: 32767
ROPE_POS: 32768
ROPE_WRAP: true
POSSCALE: 0.999987
KV_PTR_PRE: 32768
KV_PTR_POST: 0
```
liam: KV_PTR_POST -> 0 is suspicious. Maybe the tiling math folds index incorrectly when posscale < 1.0 and quantized multiply truncates.
qa-bot: Started job: https://ci.redwood/jobs/boundary-frag-1771112222 (matrix: quant=[int4v3,int4v2,int8], tile=[32k,64k], posscale=[0.9999,1.0])
rachel: does this reproduce on float32?
juan: float32/no-quant -> no repro. int8 -> clean. int4v2 -> flaky. int4v3 -> deterministic on my local env.
liam: hypothesis: int4v3 uses an imul>>shift quant kernel that floors instead of rounds, so when POS*SCALE crosses an integer boundary and RoPE triggers a wrap, the floor pushes the resulting slot index down one tile, landing in an invalid slot -> silent overwrite.
tara: can we add a guarded add before the slot modulo? like `int slot = (int)round(pos*scale) % window; if (slot < 0) slot += window;` and assert slot in [0,window).
juan: adding provisional patch + extra telemetry to record slot_pre_round and slot_post_mod. pushing in PR-6789.
qa-bot: Job queued: boundary-frag-sweep-1771112222/1
liam: also replicate with dynamic_tiling=true/false. Might be sensitive only when tiling switches mid-prefill.
juan: repro is triggered with dynamic_tiling=true and tile=32k. dynamic=false avoids it.
qa-bot: Sweep finished: reproducer signaled for int4v3 tile=32k poscale=0.9999; patch branch reduced occurrence to 0/20 runs. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/boundary-frag-1771112222/results
rachel: can you run the goldset quality eval? Need perplexity + token-flip rate pre/post patch.
juan: running now: goldset size 500 prompts ~35k tokens each.
juan: baseline float32 perplexity: 10.8
juan: int4v3 without patch perplexity: 13.4, token-flip rate: 0.021
juan: int4v3 with rounding-fix patch perplexity: 11.0, token-flip rate: 0.0015
liam: that looks like the patch restored quality near float baseline.
tara: add unit tests simulating posscale=0.9999 and RoPE wrap, assert slot monotonicity and no negative slots.
juan: done, test added to model-runtime-tests.
rachel: propose backport to release/2026-03-stable and a canary rollout to a small slice on Dedicated. No mass rollout until canary passes 24h.
liam: ack. Also set an alert on long-context token-drop events aggregate > 0.5% over 1h on canary.
qa-bot: Canary scheduled for tomorrow 06:00 UTC on dedicated-slice-7.
tara: once canary is green, update the model card with int4v3 caveats and recommended tiling configs.
juan: will open the backport PR and the canary runbook.
rachel: great triage, thanks. :clap:
juan: thanks team. will follow up with PR links and the canary outcome. :rocket:
